units.locator: Article 61. Budget process
units.text: 3. The specific features of the budgetary powers of participants in the budget process are established by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and municipal legal acts of the City Duma adopted in accordance with it, and, in cases established by them, by municipal legal acts of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 61

units.locator: Article 62. Local taxes and levies
units.text: Article 62. Local taxes and levies
units.label: Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Local taxes and levies
units.text: 1. The list of local taxes and levies is established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on taxes and levies.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Local taxes and levies
units.text: 2. Decisions of the City Duma providing for the establishment, amendment or abolition of local taxes and levies are adopted exclusively on the submission of the Head of Yekaterinburg or with an opinion from the Head.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Local taxes and levies
units.text: 3. Revenue from local taxes and levies is credited to the municipal budget at tax rates established by the City Duma in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on taxes and levies.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 62. Local taxes and levies
units.text: 4. The procedure for introducing local taxes or levies, their duration, tax rates, and the procedure and deadlines for their payment are determined by the City Duma in accordance with legislation.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 62

units.locator: Article 63. Accounting for and monitoring payment of taxes and levies
units.text: Article 63. Accounting for and monitoring payment of taxes and levies
units.label: Art. 63

units.locator: Article 63. Accounting for and monitoring payment of taxes and levies
units.text: Accounting for and monitoring payment of taxes and levies into the municipal budget are carried out by the Federal Tax Service; for certain non-tax payments, they are carried out by an authorized body in accordance with an instruction of the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Art. 63 · text

units.locator: Article 64. Municipal borrowing
units.text: Article 64. Municipal borrowing
units.label: Art. 64

units.locator: Article 64. Municipal borrowing
units.text: The Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” may undertake municipal borrowing, including through the issuance of municipal securities, in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and this Charter.
units.label: Art. 64 · “The Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” may undertake…”

units.locator: Article 64. Municipal borrowing
units.text: Article 64-1. Municipal control
units.label: Art. 64 · “Article 64-1. Municipal control”

units.locator: Article 64. Municipal borrowing
units.text: The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg organizes and exercises municipal control over compliance with requirements established by municipal legal acts adopted on matters of local significance and, where the relevant types of control are assigned by federal laws to the powers of local self-government bodies, also municipal control over compliance with requirements established by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Art. 64 · “The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg organizes and…”

units.locator: Article 64. Municipal borrowing
units.text: The organization and exercise of types of municipal control are regulated by Federal Law of 31 July 2020 No. 248-ФЗ ‘On State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control in the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Art. 64 · “The organization and exercise of types of municipal control are…”

units.locator: Article 64. Municipal borrowing
units.text: Municipal control is to be exercised where objects of the corresponding type of control are present within the boundaries of the municipality.
units.label: Art. 64 · “Municipal control is to be exercised where objects of the…”

units.locator: Article 64. Municipal borrowing
units.text: The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg exercises certain types of federal state control (supervision) and regional state control (supervision), powers for the exercise of which have been transferred to the local self-government bodies of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”.
units.label: Art. 64 · “The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg exercises…”

units.locator: Article 64. Municipal borrowing
units.text: Article 64-2. Municipal-private partnership
units.label: Art. 64 · “Article 64-2. Municipal-private partnership”

units.locator: Article 64. Municipal borrowing
units.text: The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is the body authorized to act on behalf of the municipality as the public partner in accordance with Federal Law of 13 July 2015 No. 224-ФЗ ‘On Public-Private Partnership and Municipal-Private Partnership in the Russian Federation and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Art. 64 · “The Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is the body…”

units.text: Chapter IX. LIABILITY OF BODIES AND OFFICIALS
units.label: Chapter IX. LIABILITY OF BODIES AND OFFICIALS

units.locator: Chapter IX. LIABILITY OF BODIES AND OFFICIALS
units.text: OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT OF THE MUNICIPALITY
units.label: Chapter IX. LIABILITY OF BODIES AND OFFICIALS · “OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT OF THE MUNICIPALITY”

units.locator: Article 65. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials
units.text: Article 65. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials
units.label: Art. 65

units.locator: Article 65. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials
units.text: Local self-government bodies and officials bear liability to the population of the municipality, the state, individuals and legal entities in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Art. 65 · text

units.locator: Article 66. Liability of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to the state
units.text: Article 66. Liability of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to the state
units.label: Art. 66

units.locator: Article 66. Liability of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to the state
units.text: The liability of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to the state arises on the basis of a court decision if they violate the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, the Charter of Sverdlovsk Oblast, laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast or this Charter, or if they improperly exercise specific state powers transferred by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Art. 66 · “The liability of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to…”

units.locator: Article 66. Liability of the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to the state
units.text: The City Duma’s liability to the state also arises, according to the procedure established by federal law, if the City Duma elected (newly elected) with a legally competent composition fails to hold a meeting with the required quorum for three consecutive months.
units.label: Art. 66 · “The City Duma’s liability to the state also arises, according…”

units.locator: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population
units.text: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population
units.label: Art. 67

units.locator: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population
units.text: 1. The grounds for liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and a deputy of the City Duma to the population and the procedure for resolving the corresponding matters are determined by federal law and this Charter.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 67

units.locator: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population
units.text: 2. The population of the municipality has the right to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 67

units.locator: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population
units.text: 3. Voting to recall the Head of Yekaterinburg is held on the initiative of the population according to the procedure established by federal law and the law of Sverdlovsk Oblast for conducting a local referendum and by this Charter.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 67

units.locator: Article 67. Liability of local self-government bodies, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma to the population
units.text: 4. In accordance with federal legislation, the Head of Yekaterinburg is considered recalled if at least half of the voters registered in the municipality vote in favour of recall.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 67

units.locator: Article 68. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials to individuals and legal entities
units.text: Article 68. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials to individuals and legal entities
units.label: Art. 68

units.locator: Article 68. Liability of local self-government bodies and officials to individuals and legal entities
units.text: The liability of the municipality’s local self-government bodies and officials to individuals and legal entities arises according to the procedure established by federal laws.
units.label: Art. 68 · text

units.text: Article 69. Entry into force of this Charter

units.locator: Article 69. Entry into force of this Charter
units.text: 1. This Charter is subject to state registration and official publication (promulgation) and enters into force on 1 January 2006, except for provisions for which this Article establishes other dates for entry into force.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 69

units.locator: Article 69. Entry into force of this Charter
units.text: This Article and Article 43 enter into force on the day of official publication (promulgation) of this Charter. Payments established by Article 43 accrue from the day following the day on which the City Duma of the fourth convocation begins its work.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 69 · “This Article and Article 43 enter into force on the day of…”

units.locator: Article 69. Entry into force of this Charter
units.text: Subpoint 39 of point 2 of Article 9 and subpoint 4 of point 1 of Article 9-1 enter into force on 1 January 2008.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 69 · “Subpoint 39 of point 2 of Article 9 and subpoint 4 of point 1…”

units.text: 2. units.locator: Article 69. Entry into force of this Charter
units.text: Article 46 of the Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”, adopted by the City Duma on 16.10.95 (with the amendments specified in this Article), ceases to have effect on the day of official publication (promulgation) of this Charter.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 69 · “Article 46 of the Charter of the Municipality “City of…”

units.locator: Article 70. Operation of municipal legal acts of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” until they are brought into conformity with this Charter
units.text: Article 70. Operation of municipal legal acts of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” until they are brought into conformity with this Charter
units.label: Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Operation of municipal legal acts of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” until they are brought into conformity with this Charter
units.text: 1. Municipal legal acts in effect before the entry into force of this Charter apply insofar as they do not contradict this Charter.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 70

units.locator: Article 70. Operation of municipal legal acts of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” until they are brought into conformity with this Charter
units.text: 2. Municipal legal acts must be brought into conformity with this Charter within the time limits established by current legislation.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 70
